caption:
Four projects, a lot of late nights.

Burnline (with a friend): a satellite simulator checked against the textbook to 1 meter.
Ghost: a talking Destiny Ghost, designed and about to be printed.
Wisp: an animated face for a Raspberry Pi voice assistant.
{flow}: an AI that writes performance and award statements.

What should I build next? Best comment gets built.
